mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investments ( member_id, product_id, quantity, price_per_token, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{pricePerToken}, #{totalAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS investment_id, i.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.category, i.quantity, i.price_per_token, i.total_amount, i.created_at FROM investments i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
